mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_task( record_type, task_domain, public_id, generation_source, task_key, user_id, task_status, input_snapshot, snapshot_retention_until ) VALUES( 'REPORT_GENERATION', 'REPORT', UUID_TO_BIN(#{row.publicId}), #{row.source}, CONCAT('REPORT_TASK:', UUID()), #{row.actorId}, 'PENDING', CAST(#{row.requestSnapshot} AS JSON), DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 365 DAY) )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'RUNNING', lease_holder = #{holder}, lease_expires_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL 2 MINUTE), started_at = COALESCE(started_at, NOW(3)), error_code = NULL, error_detail = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT cancel_requested, task_status AS status, lease_holder FROM t_ai_task WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'CANCELLED', lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = 'COMPLETED', result_entity_type = 'AI_REPORT', result_entity_id = #{report}, lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, completed_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION'

UPDATE t_ai_task SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, task_status = IF(retry_count + 1 >= max_retries, 'FAILED', 'RETRY_PENDING'), next_retry_at = IF(retry_count + 1 >= max_retries, NULL, DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL POW(2, retry_count + 1) MINUTE)), lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, error_code = #{code}, error_detail = #{detail}, completed_at = IF(retry_count + 1 >= max_retries, NOW(3), NULL) WHERE id = #{id} AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_holder = #{holder}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(legacy_source_id, id) AS id, task_status AS status, user_id AS actor_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_domain = 'REPORT' AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id, id) = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET next_retry_at = NOW(3), error_code = NULL, error_detail = NULL WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id, id) = #{id} AND (#{actor} IS NULL OR user_id = #{actor}) AND task_status = 'RETRY_PENDING'
mapper.sql: COALESCE(legacy_source_id, id) AS id, BIN_TO_UUID(public_id) AS public_id, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(input_snapshot, '$.type')) AS report_type, generation_source, task_status AS status, cancel_requested, retry_count, max_retries, result_entity_id AS report_id, error_code, error_detail, created_at, started_at, completed_at, user_id AS actor_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_domain = 'REPORT' AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id, id) = #{id} AND (#{actor} IS NULL OR user_id = #{actor}) LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_domain = 'REPORT' AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND (#{actor} IS NULL OR user_id = #{actor}) ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT COALESCE(legacy_source_id, id) AS id, input_snapshot AS request_snapshot, generation_source, user_id AS actor_id FROM t_ai_task WHERE task_domain = 'REPORT' AND record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_PENDING') AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= NOW(3)) ORDER BY id LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_task SET cancel_requested = 1, task_status = IF(task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_PENDING'), 'CANCELLED', task_status), completed_at = IF(task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRY_PENDING'), NOW(3), completed_at), next_retry_at = NULL WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND COALESCE(legacy_source_id, id) = #{id} AND (#{actor} IS NULL OR user_id = #{actor}) AND task_status IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRY_PENDING')

UPDATE t_ai_task SET task_status = IF(retry_count + 1 >= max_retries, 'FAILED', 'RETRY_PENDING'), retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = IF(retry_count + 1 >= max_retries, NULL, NOW(3)), lease_holder = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, error_code = 'REPORT_TASK_LEASE_EXPIRED', error_detail = '报告生成工作进程超时或崩溃' WHERE record_type = 'REPORT_GENERATION' AND task_status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expires_at < NOW(3)
